tasks.prompt: List exactly three mechanics for a game about a lighthouse keeper. One per line, each starting with '- '. No heading, no commentary.
State the win condition of a game where the player must keep a lamp lit until dawn. Twelve words or fewer. Output the condition only.
A sword does 12 damage per hit. A boss has 96 health and no armour. How many hits are needed to defeat it? Answer with the number only.
The player starts with 3 lives, loses one per hit, and gains one life at each of 2 checkpoints they will reach. How many hits can they survive in total before game over? Answer with the number only.
Name the single core verb of a game about rowing a boat between islands. One word only.

Output a JSON object describing a game, with exactly the keys "name", "genre" and "players". Use the name Tidewatch, the genre puzzle, and 1 player. All values as strings. Output the JSON and nothing else.
Describe the difficulty curve of a four-level tutorial as exactly four bullets, one per level. One per line, each starting with '- '. No heading.
Level 1 teaches jumping. Level 2 should teach exactly one new thing. Name it in three words or fewer, and do not mention jumping.
Before a boss that requires dodging, what should the level immediately before it contain? Answer in one sentence of twenty words or fewer, and use the word 'dodge' or 'dodging'.
A game has 5 worlds with 8 levels each, plus 1 boss level per world. How many levels are there in total? Answer with the number only.
Write a one-line hook for a game set in an abandoned lighthouse. Fifteen words or fewer, mentioning the lighthouse. Output the line only.
Rewrite this so it says the same thing without the word 'fun': 'A fun game where you have fun repairing a fun little boat.' Output the rewritten sentence only.
